experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: General Procedure for Acetalization of Aldehydes : Aldehyde (5 mmol), ethane 1,2-diol (5 mmol) and metal sulfate (5 mmol) supported on silica gel (1.65 g) were mixed in a pyrex test tube and subjected to microwave irradiation for 3-6 min.
